description: This file contains Flask route handlers and view functions for a web application, including user profile editing, post management, user following, and moderation features.

methods.name: after_request
methods.description: Logs slow database queries after each app request.

methods.name: server_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the development server if in testing mode.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main page with posts, handles new post creation.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Displays a user's profile and posts.

methods.name: edit_profile
methods.description: Allows logged-in users to edit their profile.

methods.name: edit_profile_admin
methods.description: Allows admin users to edit any user's profile.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Displays a post and its comments, handles new comment submission.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Allows post authors or admins to edit a post.

methods.name: followed_by
methods.description: Show users followed by a user.

methods.name: show_all
methods.description: Set cookie to show all posts.

methods.name: show_followed
methods.description: Set cookie to show only followed posts.
